capabilities: Collect notes on a topic from search results or by following note connections
Define connections such as text links, frontmatter links, YAML tags, regex prefixes, or custom code
Define rules that control how connections are followed (to the end, N steps, or by probability)
Highlight the selected subset of notes to focus on
Show the graph view only for the selected topic's notes
extras: The README labels the arbitrary connection type as danger: it runs any code the user places in a Markdown code block.
motivation: The author wants to help users work with subtopics in a clear and simple way, regardless of how structure is defined in the vault.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to isolate and work with just the notes on one subtopic when they are spread across folders, tags, and link structures.

relations.evidence: You can use my other plugin, Ignore Filters Boost, to add every folder except the focused one

summary: Note-selection tool that collects the subset of vault notes on one topic using configurable connections and traversal rules, for focused work.
